title: Orunmila session header, schema version 1: DRAFT
description: Every session's raw log begins with a header record, and the hash chain starts from it. It records everything needed to reproduce the session's results. Replay reads these values from the header, never from current settings.
$comment: brief v3 line 282 lists what the header holds but names no fields: every field name here is the agent's choice (LD16). Draft from Phase 1 slice A1; built in slice A10. Unknown fields are allowed (line 209).

record.description: Marks this line as the header, so a reader tells it from a mark without guessing.

seq.description: The header is the first record of the raw log; marks follow from seq 1.
seq.$comment: brief v3 lines 237, 282; 0 for the header is the agent's choice, LD10

observed_at.description: Wall-clock time the session started, for humans only.

mono_ns.description: The monotonic clock at session start, as a decimal string of the integer.
mono_ns.$comment: brief v3 line 238; brief v4 line 238 (open point P1, decided 2026-11-16)

code_fingerprint.description: A fingerprint of Orunmila's own code at session start; a change mid-session is a tampering mark.
code_fingerprint.$comment: agent: ledger A3 and NF41, phase1-plan A10; not in brief line 282

version.description: The agent's version, null when unknown.

accounts.description: User accounts: the agent's, and the one Orunmila's files belong to (the same account until the separate-user setup in Phase 5).

agent_user.description: The account the agent runs as.

orunmila_user.description: The account that owns Orunmila's logs.

project_root.description: The session header records the project root, so a Glove mark and a sentinel mark for one file always join.
project_root.$comment: brief v3 line 339. An absolute path (POSIX, or a Windows drive).

config.description: Every configured value (quiet window, ceiling, lag grace, exclusions).
config.$comment: brief v3 line 282; other configured values are allowed beside these

diff_size_limit_bytes.description: The size limit over which a diff is not kept (`no_diff: too_large`), a configured value recorded in the session header.

frozen.description: The fingerprints of every frozen configuration file (rules, byproducts, ignore list, law packs, agent hook settings) as they were at session start. null when the file does not exist.

law_packs.description: Every law pack in use (Orunmila's canon and any project law pack), by name.

hook_settings.description: The agent's own hook configuration files, by path. A change mid-session is recorded as a tampering mark; it cannot be held back (NF42, approved by O 2026-11-15).
hook_settings.$comment: brief v3 line 343, as amended for hook settings by O's NF42 decision

hooks_report.description: Which tool calls the agent's hooks can report before and after they run. Where an agent cannot report before a tool runs, the session header says so.
hooks_report.$comment: brief v3 lines 282, 337. Each list holds tool names, or "*" for every tool (agent's choice, LD16); an empty list means none.

prev_hash.description: The hash chain starts from the header, so it has no previous hash.

hash.description: The header's own hash; the first mark's prev_hash.

fingerprint.description: Plain SHA-256, or keyed HMAC-SHA-256 for files on the redaction list; null when the file does not exist.
